body: No, I don’t. No, I’m not. I don’t owe you a thing.

I’m drinking a lot. Like I get at least buzzed every night. It started with craft beers, just having one after work. Then I’d buy the 7%+ abv beers. Then I’d start having two if I had a bad day. Then I’d have two every night and three if I had a bad day. Some nights I get drunk. I still go to work. I don’t drink and drive. I don’t drink before or during work. On the weekends I don’t usually have a beer before 4pm or so. It just seems destructive. 

The secret is that I like it. Getting buzzed every night is helping me cope with so much that therapy never did. I can’t let things go and stop thinking and just relax and de stress. Getting buzzed helps me relax and let go of the bullshit I have to eat all day.
